title: A KIT IS FOR ONE RAID
why: From the cloud code review (findings 20 and 32). A RANDOM KIT or BEST KIT kept as your pick used to rewrite your hands, your gun keys and your packing every time you went up afterwards, and the lift quick ascent did it without showing any page. Now a kit is for the raid you pick it for. The pick stays on the map select screen until you go up with it, then falls back to MY LOADOUT, so the next time the screen opens on your own loadout. While a kit is picked the line under the row says THIS RAID ONLY. The quick ascent never applies a kit and takes what you packed. RANDOM KIT and BEST KIT also leave alone a gun you locked in the stash: it is never picked and never moved into the armoury.
now: A kit is for one raid: the pick resets to MY LOADOUT, and a locked gun is never taken.
